status: FROZEN before any candidate-specific market statistic is read. Edits after the freeze commit invalidate the registration.

authority.ladder_level: L1 only (a pass is reported as L1 and nothing higher)

hypothesis: Coins with recent lottery-like payoffs (large single-day gains) are overpriced and earn lower subsequent returns; the cross-sectional rank of -MAX3 predicts forward returns positively.

signal.formula: r(i,tau) = C(i,tau)/C(i,tau-1) - 1 from daily closes; MAX3(i,t) = mean of the 3 largest r(i,tau) for tau in {t-27..t}; S(i,t) = -MAX3(i,t)
signal.direction: higher S = less lottery-like = predicted to earn MORE; the test is one-sided (mean IC > 0)
signal.availability: S(i,t) is computed when the daily candle of day t completes (00:00 UTC of day t+1) from completed candles <= t only
signal.validity: S is missing unless all 28 returns exist (29 consecutive positive closes) and the whole window lies inside one identity epoch of the S4 epoch table
signal.ties: average ranks; a constant cross-section gives no IC for that day

returns.definition: R(i,t,h) = Open(i,t+1+h) / Open(i,t+1) - 1 (open to open, simple return); entry is the open of the day after the signal day, i.e. the 'next candle open' fill of the engine, assumed zero-latency for L1
returns.missing_exit: if the exit candle is missing (gap or delisting inside the horizon) the exit is the last observed close in [t+1, t+h]; no recovery and no total loss is invented
returns.missing_entry: no entry candle: the asset has no observation that day
returns.sensitivity_not_gating: assets with no candle from t+1+h on are assigned R = -1 (zero recovery); reported only
returns.costs: none at L1 (L1 makes no cost or tradability claim)

universe.source: PitDataset.universe_at(first day of the month of t, '5M', max_stale_days=3): S4 causal liquidity eligibility (median 90-day USDT quote volume >= 5 M, >= 60 completed daily candles in the 90 days, last candle at most 3 days old at the month start), explicit asset classification (stablecoins, fiat, leveraged and commodity tokens excluded), delisted symbols included; membership is fixed for the calendar month

evaluation.data: Binance Vision spot monthly 1d klines, research use only, via the verified PIT loader (sha256 of every file checked against the S4 manifest)
evaluation.last_candle_note: the last daily candle the loader may serve as completed before the holdout cutoff (2025-07-01); the holdout is never read

regime.definition: sign of the trailing 90-day close-to-close return of BTCUSDT at the signal date (up if > 0, down otherwise); reported only, not gating

statistics.statistic: mean over signal days of the daily cross-sectional Spearman IC between S(.,t) and R(.,t,h), members of the month's universe with valid S and R
statistics.hac_note: Newey-West, Bartlett kernel, lag = 2h (14 for h = 7, 56 for h = 28): the h-day forward returns overlap, so the IC series is MA(h-1); 2h is a conservative margin fixed ex ante
statistics.inference: one-sided normal approximation of t = mean / HAC standard error
statistics.bootstrap_check: circular block bootstrap of the mean IC, block length = max(lag, 2), 999 draws; reported, not gating
reported: two-sided 95 % confidence interval and one-sided 95 % lower bound
effective sample size = n * (naive se / HAC se)^2
assets per day, coverage, missing signal/return counts

multiple_testing.primary: Holm across the 2 registered configurations (family-wise one-sided alpha 0.05)
multiple_testing.relevant_historical_tests: none: none of the 43 earlier configurations evaluated a lottery/MAX signal; they tested other strategy families on other claims, so they do not enter this family's correction. Interpretation recorded here before any result; the owner's phrase 'any relevant historical hypothesis tests' is read as 'tests of the same hypothesis or signal', of which there are 0.
multiple_testing.program_wide_sensitivity_not_gating: Bonferroni across the whole research programme (N = 45): per-test alpha 0.05/45 = 0.001111; reported next to the primary result so the effect of the stricter reading is visible

criteria.practical_threshold_rule: mean IC_h >= 0.003522504892367907 * sqrt(h): the S9 break-even IC (H1, turnover 12, cost 0.15 %, margin 2) scaled by sqrt(h), the large-persistence relation between a per-day IC and an h-day IC; the scaling is an assumption (see the horizon power study)
criteria.stability: mean IC > 0 in BOTH sub-periods P1 and P2
criteria.pass_rule: L1 PASS iff at least one configuration meets ALL of: data gates (valid days >= 1000, mean assets >= 30, coverage >= 0.80), Holm-corrected p <= 0.05, practical threshold, stability; AND the disguise check passes; AND the causality and reproducibility checks pass
criteria.otherwise: NO-GO: H1 is terminated. No window optimisation, signal change, alternative horizon or additional filter is permitted.

disguise.method: for each reference style, the mean over signal days of the cross-sectional Spearman correlation between S and the style's value; the gating quantity is the maximum absolute mean correlation

reference_styles.realised_vol_28d_informational: std of 28 daily returns; informational, not gating

disguise.termination: max |mean correlation| over the five gating styles > 0.7 => treated as a disguised rejected style => NO-GO

causality_and_reproducibility_checks.rule: S computed on the panel truncated at each date equals S of the full panel for every day up to that date (exact equality)
causality_and_reproducibility_checks.reproducibility: the full evaluation is computed twice in one process and once in a separate process; the canonical result hashes must be identical
causality_and_reproducibility_checks.data_integrity: every candle file is verified against the S4 manifest sha256 by the loader; any mismatch aborts the run

budget.accounting: charged before the results are read; the run happens once; a re-run of the identical registered code does not add to N

known_limitations: Binance listing dates and Binance-only prices; research-only licence
zero-latency entry at the open after the signal; L2 must use engine fills and costs
signal persistence and the IC scaling to h days are assumptions (m2_horizon_power_results.json)
survivorship is handled by including delisted symbols, but the identity-epoch table is curated-unverified for ticker semantics
H1 is a hypothesis; its literature is not verified in this environment

requires: family h1_lottery_max3 registered in protocol/research_budget.json with status preregistered and no market run consumed
an owner approval entry in protocol/run_approvals.json for this exact spec hash
the data store holds only 1d files of months < 2025-07 (the loader refuses anything else)
run_guard.single_run: the registered evaluation is executed once; its result file is the only result; a second identical execution is a reproducibility check, not a new experiment
